description: Directed driving-lane topology and lane-centreline metadata for the CobraFlex RoadRunner handover map.

source.derivation: Driving Lane LineString features and their RoadRunner predecessor/successor metadata. Backward-travel lanes are reoriented so topology follows vehicle travel direction.

coordinate_frame.name: RoadRunner local metric frame
coordinate_frame.conversion_from_geojson: WGS84 local conversion at origin: x = lon_deg * 111319.49079327357; y = lat_deg * 110574.27582159435; z unchanged.
